summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the 'Empresa → Tendencias' refined anti-duplicate warning. Both MSFT (not-already-in) and NVDA (already-in) scenarios behave exactly as specified. All assertions in tests A, B and C passed.
critical_code_review_comments: ThesisResult.jsx is ~490 lines and contains many sub-components (TrendCard, CompanyCard, StageRow, ContraSection, SourcesList, TamScoreBadge). Approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting before adding more logic.
Trend slug for data-testid uses _norm(t.name).slice(0,16) plus idx — collision risk is mitigated by the idx suffix, OK.
thesisLinkSuggestions runs on every company-thesis load; consider server-side caching by (thesis_id, trends signature) to reduce LLM cost.
test_credentials: Cookie session_token=test_profile_token_fixed_123 on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL host. Seeded via seed_profile_test.py + seed_company_thesis_test.py.
seed_data_creation: Re-seeded profile + company theses (MSFT, NVDA) before testing to undo the mutation introduced by iteration_5 test 4 (which had added MSFT to thesis_test_aidc).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tests are read-only (no thesis generation, no add-company click). State remains clean. MSFT thesis correctly shows trend-dup-msg + trend-add button ('Añadir MSFT a esa tesis'); NVDA thesis correctly shows trend-already-in ('NVIDIA ya está en esta tesis: IA y centros de datos. ... no la añadas de nuevo para no inflar su valor') with dup-link href=/thesis/thesis_test_aidc and NO trend-add button. trend-generate-anyway link is present in both cases.
